feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: 17 films to see before New Year's, from Oscar-bait to blockbusters
entry.summary: This winter, Pedro Pascal plays a cellist, Julianne Moore takes on community theater, and Andrew Garfield shows us Sam Altman's rise at the head of OpenAI.

entry.title: French cinema star Gérard Depardieu ordered to stand trial for rape and sexual assault
entry.summary: The case has become one of the most prominent in France's reckoning with sexual violence, as the #MeToo movement has faced resistance in the country, particularly in the arts.

entry.title: From Thanksgiving blackouts to Black Friday, a holiday hit by wild weather and economic woes
entry.summary: A storm battered much of the country on Thursday, knocking out power to thousands of homes and disrupting travel. Today, Black Friday shopping deals kick off, and on Saturday New York City will hold the postponed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

entry.title: Can luxury save Macy's?
entry.summary: This week's celebration of Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade finds the department store at a turning point. After years of losing sales, the retailer is reimagining itself — as a higher-end destination.

entry.title: 'All of a Sudden' is over 3 hours long. Our critic can't wait to see it a third time
entry.summary: Justin Chang says this is the best movie he's seen all year. It follows a friendship between two women in Paris — one runs an elder-care facility; the other is a theater director visiting from Kyoto.

entry.title: Trump effectively ended asylum. Advocates look to the Supreme Court to restore it
entry.summary: Trump's sweeping immigration changes — an asylum ban, mass firings and new legal maneuvers — have all but ended asylum. The high court will soon consider whether some shifts deny people due process.

entry.title: Screen-free tweens try their hand at Dungeons & Dragons
entry.summary: Some parents, fed up with screens, have found an analog oasis in the role-playing game invented in the 1970s.

entry.title: The jewels of Route 66: Neon signs are making a comeback
entry.summary: To commemorate the centennial of the famous highway, cities like Tulsa are investing in an old-fashioned technology.

entry.title: 12 strategies to cut your risk of dementia. Take this quiz to start
entry.summary: Here's something you can do as you gather with family and friends this holiday season: Take a free, five-minute quiz to assess your brain health. You'll learn simple changes to keep your mind sharp.

entry.title: Eagles rally to stun Cowboys coming back from 21 points behind
entry.summary: Eagles QB Joe Milton threw two long touchdowns against the quarterback's former team, the Dallas Cowboys, for the the start of quite a comeback, after being down 31-10 early in the third quarter.
